name: varg-mockups
description: Mock up a video before paying for it: one self-contained HTML board (storyboard board, moodboard, reference board, look test, plan page, contact sheet) with numbered frames, shot specs, prompts, approve / needs-fix / reject and a note per frame, side-by-side variants and feedback copied as Markdown; stills made on varg (Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image 2.5) that do not look like AI slop and stay consistent (character sheets, environment master first, same lens and light); device and app UI mockups (iMessage chat, Apple Notes, iPhone fold, phone stamp carousel, terminals, code editors). Use for "mock up", "mock up a look", "mockup", "storyboard board", "moodboard", "reference board", "look test", "stills for approval", "key frames to approve", "shot board", "phone mockup", "app UI mockup", "screen mockup", or stills that look like AI slop or drift between shots. Not for final video clips (varg-video-prompting) or 3D camera blocking (threejs-animatic).
